otherFindings.summary: The "Astana" time-zone mapping changes from Asia/Dhaka to Asia/Almaty, so affected readers' reminder times show one hour off.
Action Text `to_plain_text` output changes (drops script/style text, new `<ol>` numbering), which affects Markdown exports and previews.
The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1, and moving to Sidekiq 7.3+ with redis-client would silently break `sadd` truthiness and the Redis error rescues.
Trix packaging changed: action_text-trix supplies Trix 2 CSS while the vendored Trix 1.3.5 JS stays, so the editor styling may not match.
Adopting the 7.1 HTML5 sanitizer vendor default changes the Action Text default allowlist base.
